cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — kneeling on the ground; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — standing; a small amateur astronomy club's indoor planetarium after a rehearsal — she removes an oversized lightweight foam planet prop from her lap; a silent zero-gravity recreation chamber on an orbital station — she playfully redirects the floating soft ball with one open palm; an archery range of targets on a green field — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — sitting on the ground; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing; the entryway of her home with a shoe bench — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a sunlit white marble temple — standing; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; her living room with a deep sofa — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a red carpet and award hall with camera flashes — standing; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — standing
